# Luke Libby

> Creative Technologist and Product Builder

I design and build the systems behind useful digital products — turning messy workflows into clear interfaces, prototypes, AI tools, and internal platforms. Portfolio covers AI workflows, internal tools, outdoor products, and learning systems.

Creative technologist and product builder with ten-plus years at Pluralsight and freelance work across AI systems, video production, hands-on labs, and practical software.

- Contact: https://lukelibby.com/#contact
- Resume PDF: https://lukelibby.com/resume.pdf
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/luke-libby1/

## Site
- [Home](https://lukelibby.com/): Luke Libby — Creative Technologist and Product Builder. Gallery of published product work: AI workflows, internal tools, outdoor products, and learning systems.
- [Work archive](https://lukelibby.com/work): Archive index of product case studies and brand systems. Prefer individual /work/:slug project pages for current write-ups.

## Work
- [OVRmaps](https://lukelibby.com/work/ovrmaps): Founded outdoor maps product (formerly referenced as GearTraxx): maps, GPS recording, trail observations, and community sharing. Published mobile + web.
- [WyldTracks](https://lukelibby.com/work/wyldtracks): Independent wildlife field journal: photo-first capture, evidence-backed IDs, GBIF validation, and a personal observation record. Live at wyldtracks.com.
- [Play It Pro](https://lukelibby.com/work/play-it-pro): Independent music education platform for teachers, students, and tutorial authors: structured lessons, learning paths, and a curated tutorial library.
- [SlideKit](https://lukelibby.com/work/slidekit): PowerPoint standards add-in. Slide review time down ~28% and slide creation time down ~34% by catching presentation problems before video production.
- [VideoKit](https://lukelibby.com/work/videokit): Internal AI-assisted video review workflow for findings, status, and standards checks in one place. Reviewers reported about 30% less time in review.
- [Plottr](https://lukelibby.com/work/plottr): Presentation review product: import a deck, check it against standards, and export actionable findings without treating the original file as the only source of truth.
- [Luma](https://lukelibby.com/work/luma): Technology-course review system for objectives, concepts, procedures, and tools. Content quality review dropped by about 90% via structured spot-checks.
- [AI-Assisted Lab Production](https://lukelibby.com/work/ai-lab-production): AI-assisted hands-on lab production workflow that speeds drafting while keeping code checks, instructional judgment, and final approval with a person.

## Brand & Interface Systems
- [Terrapin Outdoors](https://lukelibby.com/brand-systems/terrapin-outdoors): Map-first outdoor platform design system with foundations, map shells, and field-ready components (supports OVRmaps).
- [Replenish Health](https://lukelibby.com/brand-systems/replenish-health): Dark-mode design system for a health platform with brand pillars, tokens, and dashboard UI.
